verdict.rationale: Zero's own MCP documentation lists AI tools to "ask questions about mailbox content" and "ask questions about specific email threads," which covers the inbox-wide Q&A core of the story. Calendar is never mentioned, and the docs are one-line feature bullets that don't show how answers are grounded or cited. missing for 10: calendar coverage, evidence that answers are grounded in or cite source emails, detail on cross-inbox query depth (e.g., who said what, outstanding items), independent or hands-on corroboration.
